name: Implicit work must enter the resource owner set

payload.description: An explicit statement recursively or implicitly touches another table/resource after admission ownership is frozen.
payload.proof_question: Does the hidden resource enter MDL, lock, schema, or retry ownership before a conflicting transition can invalidate the plan?
payload.required_test: Pause after the explicit executor is built, run a conflicting transition on the hidden resource, resume implicit work, and use a direct consistency oracle.
payload.negative_screen: Runtime rematerialization under the latest schema can be a valid guard even when the conflicting transition completes before hidden work starts.

provenance.source: FK cascade versus ADD INDEX local matrix

name: FK cascade must mutate child with a schema valid at execution

payload.p_check: Parent DELETE executor is built before child ADD INDEX completes.
payload.q_claim: The later cascade cannot omit the newly public child index mutation.
payload.result: GREEN: runtime cascade planning registered the child and maintained the new index.

name: Cascade child row and new-index consistency

observations: ADD INDEX completes before parent DELETE first run
parent and cascaded child row disappear after commit
forced new-index lookup returns no deleted row
payload.red: row deleted but newly public index still returns the row or ADMIN CHECK reports inconsistency
payload.green: table and new-index rowsets are both empty

title: FK cascade built before child ADD INDEX might omit new index mutation

payload.matrix: pause parent DELETE before first executor run; complete child ADD INDEX; resume DELETE and commit
payload.result: ADMIN CHECK green and forced new-index query empty
payload.do_not_repeat: Do not reopen without a different hidden-resource owner or a plan cached past runtime cascade preprocessing.

rationale: Cascade is an implicit child-table write not named by the parent DELETE syntax.
The new index must agree with the cascaded child rowset.

environment.shape: parent DELETE ON DELETE CASCADE paused after executor build; child ADD INDEX idx_v(v) completed before resume

evidence.ddl: ADD INDEX completed before cascade execution
evidence.oracle: ADMIN CHECK TABLE child passed; forced idx_v query returned no deleted child
evidence.owner: related MDL table IDs included parent and child after cascade execution

lessons.guard: Cascade work is rematerialized at runtime against the current child schema.
lessons.selector_refinement: A late implicit owner is not a bug if runtime plan rematerialization consumes the latest schema before mutation.
lessons.harness_lesson: The repository breakpoint is a no-op without failpoint source rewriting; the final matrix used a temporary direct hook and removed it afterward.
